claim_verdicts.evidence: Round 2: definition of the lesson's own vocab term from outline item 1, now adding that a config file in the vendor's format counts under code. A framing choice, not a documented fact.

Definitional within the four-part framing (contract terms = notice period / minimum term of a paid agreement). No version-dependent behaviour; detail deferred to management.l3.vendor-contract-terms per depth_notes.
Follows from the lesson's own definition (code/data cost = sum over points of use); restates outline item 2. Conditional reasoning, not a documented behaviour.

Tautological as worded: what a standard defines is by definition the same across providers. Round 2: its application to access-token checking is now conditioned (claim 20), so the round-1 concern no longer applies.

Matches outline item 5 and the repo: keycloak/donhang-realm.json is Keycloak's realm export format (protocolMapper entries 'oidc-audience-mapper', 'oidc-usermodel-realm-role-mapper'); ADR 0009 line 65 puts accounts in Keycloak's database. Being able to keep running OSS is a licence property, not a versioned behaviour.
ADR 0009 line 67: 'Đội chấp nhận mức lock-in này: đổi cả ba chỗ vẫn rẻ hơn khoản tiết kiệm.' The lesson states the condition ('as long as the decision says so') rather than an unconditional rule.

Program.cs lines 54-57 read exactly as the block's comment. Re-read in round 2 from the submodule working tree (git show was again refused by the permission system); block lines 54-74 match character for character.

Round 2 wording matches the round-1 suggested text. OIDC Discovery 1.0 §4: the document is at 'the path formed by concatenating the string /.well-known/openid-configuration to the Issuer'; §3 jwks_uri: 'URL of the OP's JWK Set document ... contains the signing key(s) the RP uses to validate signatures'. Program.cs line 65 uses that default.

ASP.NET Core 'Mapping, customizing, and transforming claims': 'disable the namespaces per scheme ... use the MapInboundClaims = false option'; 'If ... the roles are missing, check the values in the returned claims and set the NameClaimType and the RoleClaimType values.' Code lines 70-73 match. realm json lines 47-51: mapper 'realm roles as roles', claim.name 'roles'.

Round 2 gloss now 'the space that holds its users, roles and sign-in settings'. Keycloak Server Administration Guide: 'A realm manages a set of users, credentials, roles, and groups.' / 'A realm is a space where you manage objects, including users, applications, roles, and groups.' (docs/latest; pinned 26.7 is in the 26.x line.)

ADR 0009 lines 56-65, '### Lock-in' (heading at line 56): '`DonHang.Api/Program.cs` đọc vai trò từ claim `roles` mà realm thêm vào token' / '`keycloak/donhang-realm.json` là định dạng riêng của Keycloak.' / 'Tài khoản khách và mật khẩu đã băm nằm trong database của Keycloak.'

ADR 0009 lines 58-59: 'API nói chuyện với Keycloak qua OpenID Connect, chuẩn mà dịch vụ đăng nhập khác cũng dùng, nên phần lớn code không biết nó đang dùng Keycloak.' Line 67: 'đổi cả ba chỗ vẫn rẻ hơn khoản tiết kiệm.'

GatewayRefundClient.cs 61: HttpMethod.Post, "v1/refunds"; 63: new { orderId = refund.OrderId, amountVnd = refund.AmountVnd }; 65: Headers.Add("Idempotency-Key", ...); 69: IsSuccessStatusCode -> Refunded; 70-71: UnprocessableEntity -> Refused with ReadReasonAsync; 72: else TryAgainLater. Block lines 49-73 match the source.

GatewayRefundClient.cs 40-43: '... nothing else in Đơn Hàng ever sees a gateway response.' DonHang.Payments/Program.cs 104-105: 'http.BaseAddress = new Uri(gateway.BaseAddress); http.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", gateway.ApiKey);' inside AddGatewayRefundClient. Round 2 claim and lesson now state both.

Round 2 wording matches the round-1 suggested text. RefundSender.cs 91, 99 branch on result.Outcome; 102 'refund.FailureReason = result.Reason;' and 104 pass result.Reason into the payment.refund-failed message; nothing parses it, and no HTTP type appears.

Round 2 wording matches the round-1 suggested text. ADR 0010 'Kế hoạch rời đi' step 2: 'Viết một client mới cho cổng mới, trả đúng ba kết quả mà GatewayRefundClient trả, kèm test của nó. Saga hoàn tiền, RefundSender và các service khác không đổi.' Program.cs 104-105 set the Bearer auth in the registration.

ASP.NET Core Authentication overview: 'An authentication scheme's forbid action is called by Authorization when an authenticated user attempts to access a resource they're not permitted to access.' Configure JWT bearer line 101: 'A 403 Forbidden response typically indicates that the authenticated user lacks the necessary permissions ... distinct from authentication issues, such as an invalid token'.
Conditional design opinion ('pays where a vendor's terms would otherwise spread'), matching outline misconception 3; no documented behaviour involved.

ADR 0009 '### Kế hoạch rời đi' (heading line 69), lines 75-76: 'Chuyển tài khoản: xuất người dùng từ Keycloak; nếu nơi mới không nhận được mật khẩu đã băm, khách đặt lại mật khẩu lần đăng nhập đầu.' Also supports the new section 6 symptom sentence.

configure-jwt-bearer-authentication.md line 48, access tokens: 'Can vary in format. Different APIs might use different formats for the tokens.' Lines 124-126: validate 'Signature', 'Issuer claim with the expected value', 'Audience claim with the expected value'. OIDC Discovery §3 jwks_uri lists the signing keys. Program.cs 68 Audience = "donhang-api". The condition stated is what the code needs.

DonHang.Payments/Program.cs line 56: 'options.TokenValidationParameters.RoleClaimType = "roles";' (line 59 RequireRole("staff")). ADR 0009 '### Lock-in' names only DonHang.Api/Program.cs. Read from the submodule working tree; git show stage-3 was refused by the permission system.

Hedged comparison ('doubtful'), labelled opinion. Its factual parts are covered by claims 14, 16 (gateway code in one class plus registration), 2 (contract part of paid vendors) and 11 (accounts in Keycloak's database).
